help.title: About Construction updates
help.overview: A Construction update is a progress post with body and media, aimed at a project or a specific edifice. Use it for site communication (what was built this week). It is not a Story (marketing journal) and not a snag (defect).

sections.title: What it holds
items: Optional links to a milestone or schedule task when those construction records exist.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create updates as work progresses; filter by project or edifice.
These can surface on the public site or client communications when the form marks them that way.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Does not move unit status or completion dates by itself.
Edifice actual completion and unit construction status remain on those records — update them there if the building is actually finished.

sections.title: Related records
items: Project, optional edifice. Complementary to Stories (marketing) and Snags (defects).
